title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 15

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the booking system open?
tasks.audioText: The college is introducing a new online booking system for practical rooms. The system will open to students next Monday at eight in the morning. Before booking, students must check the room's equipment list and ask their tutor to approve the session. A short guide is available in the student portal, and technical support will be available during the first week.
options: Next Monday at eight in the morning
Next Tuesday at eight in the morning
Next Monday at nine in the morning
Next Monday at eight in the morning

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What must students do before booking?
tasks.audioText: The college is introducing a new online booking system for practical rooms. The system will open to students next Monday at eight in the morning. Before booking, students must check the room's equipment list and ask their tutor to approve the session. A short guide is available in the student portal, and technical support will be available during the first week.
options: On Friday
Check the equipment list and get tutor approval
Next month
After the event

tasks.prompt: When the college introduced an online booking system, some students were unsure how to reserve specialist rooms. The support team collected questions and updated the guide with screenshots and clear steps. Tutors also demonstrated the process during lessons. After the first month, fewer booking errors were reported, although the college continued to review feedback and make small improvements. Reading 1. How did the support team improve the guide?
options: They removed technical terms from the guide
They added screenshots and clear steps
They added screenshots and clear steps
They replaced the guide with a video

tasks.prompt: What changed after the first month?
options: More students cancelled their room bookings
Fewer booking errors were reported
The college stopped reviewing feedback
Fewer booking errors were reported

tasks.prompt: The guide ___ regularly as the booking system changes.
options: should be updated
should updating
updates yesterday
is update

tasks.prompt: Choose TWO ways to help users adapt to a new online system.
options: Hide the help information
Assume everyone understands the system
Provide clear step-by-step instructions
Collect feedback and improve the guide

tasks.prompt: A series of actions or instructions for completing a task is a ___.
A student reports that the booking page is confusing. What is a constructive reply?
options: You are the only person who has a problem.
Thank you for telling us. Could you show us which step is unclear?
Ignore it and try again next term.
The system cannot be changed.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of communicating about change in a logical order.
options: Support users during the change
Explain why the new system is being introduced
Review feedback and improve the process
Publish clear instructions
correctOrder: Explain why the new system is being introduced
Review feedback and improve the process

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how a college should introduce a new digital system. Include communication, user support and feedback.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains how the new system will be introduced and how users will be informed (0–2); it includes user support and a way to collect and act on feedback (0–2); the rollout is logically sequenced with understandable grammar (0–2); digital-system/change-management vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
